body.name: unscreened nonnegative-projection plug-in
body.construction: Compute the totalized conditional proportions \(\widehat q^d_{n,z,x,k}\), form \((\widehat w_n)_x=\widehat p_{n,x}(\widehat\ell_{n,x,0},\ldots,\widehat\ell_{n,x,K-1},\widehat h_{n,x,0},\ldots,\widehat h_{n,x,K-1})^{\prime}\), apply \(\widehat v_n=\Pi_+\widehat w_n\) coordinatewise without deleting any cell, evaluate every displayed cut and mass branch, and divide by \(\widehat M_n^{\dagger}\) to form \((\widehat\theta_{L,n},\widehat\theta_{U,n})\).
